overall_reason: The range and type segmented controls mark their selection, the table has a sort mark and right-aligned amounts, and the empty state offers a way out, but the 'Owner: Ada' remove button changes nothing and the draft reply looks like a field it is not.

score.reason: T-WHERE-AM-I and T-TABLE-READ pass at 1440, but T-ERROR-PATH fails on the filter's remove button and T-STATE-MATRIX finds no pressed or disabled styles (CMP-003, CMP-002).

visitor_mode: Operate (inferred: a weekly operations dashboard; the page calls itself the 'After' version of a shared fixture, styled by one design skill)

findings.title: Waiting, failure and success belong to the action
findings.where: button 'Remove filter Owner: Ada' (the x on the owner chip), 1440, async/a0-slow-0.5s.png and a0-slow-2s.png
findings.evidence: The async run clicked the chip's remove button and recorded 'responded: false' at 0.5 s and at 2 s, no request and no new text. a0-slow-2s.png shows the x in its red hover look with the 'Owner: Ada' chip still in place.
findings.before: Clicking the x leaves the filter applied and the table unchanged.
findings.after: The chip leaves, the table and the three totals update, and an 'Owner filter removed. Undo' note sits where the chip was.
findings.why: A remove control that does nothing makes the operator doubt every other filter on the page.

findings.title: Every state a control can reach is designed
findings.evidence: The readable stylesheet (97 rules, 1 sheet unreadable) declares 12 hover rules and 1 focus-visible rule, but 0 :active, 0 disabled and 0 busy rules. The sweep's focus_ring hit records the focus look on the link 'Text the plant' at 2.30:1 against rest (A11-003, Reflex).
findings.before: Controls have a hover look and a single focus rule, with no pressed, disabled or loading look.
findings.after: A pressed step on the segments and buttons, a busy label for 'Send follow-up', and the focus ring declared for every control family.
findings.why: Without a pressed or busy look the operator gets no sign that a click landed before the data changes.

findings.title: Every navigation item and action goes somewhere
findings.where: li.type-draft > div.body > div.draft ('Thanks for the update. Can you send the revised PO by Thursday?'), 1440, tiles/1440-00.png y 842-885
findings.evidence: The draft reply sits in a bordered, rounded box with a white fill that matches a text field, under the label 'Unsent reply to Harbor'. The components table finds no field on the page: the box is a div, so it cannot be edited or sent from here.
findings.before: The unsent draft is drawn as an input box that does not accept input and has no Send or Edit action.
findings.after: Either a real textarea with 'Send reply' beside it, or the draft shown as quoted text with an 'Edit draft' link.
findings.why: A box that looks editable invites a click that does nothing.

findings.title: Tables read as tables
findings.evidence: The table is 576 px wide inside a 375 px viewport (at_375.wider_than_screen). The sweep's phone_parity hit (ROB-002) records 124 words shown at 1440 and hidden at 375 under #h-urgent, and tiles/375-00.png and 375-01.png show the filters and then blank page down to the footer.
findings.before: At 375 the urgent-threads table is wider than the screen and did not render in the capture.
findings.after: At 375 each thread as a stacked row: account name first, then status, change and amount, with the table kept for wider screens.
findings.why: On a phone the operator loses the one table the dashboard exists to show.

strengths: The 'Range' and 'Type' segmented controls mark the selected segment ('7 days', 'All') with a white fill and blue text, so the operator sees which view the table shows.
The 'Account' head carries a sort mark and the Change and Amount columns are right-aligned (3 numeric cells aligned right), so the table reads as a table at 1440.
The empty state exists in the DOM with a recovery line: 'No matching threads in this filter. Try 30 days or clear the owner filter.'
A skip link is the first focus stop, and 'How this note was chosen' uses a disclosure instead of a dialog.

The DOM gives 'Send follow-up' the button.btn-accent class and 'Snooze' button.btn-secondary, one primary and one secondary (their rendered look is not verified: the section stayed hidden in the capture).
not_investigated: Visitor mode inferred from the page; there is no 00-contract.md.

The 'Empty', 'Reach them' and 'Send follow-up' sections (section.reveal) stayed at opacity 0 in the 1440 capture and the pending feed and urgent table stayed at opacity 0 at 375; they appear with reduced motion and with scripts off (hidden.json). Whether they reveal on a real scroll is not verified; this is robustness (ROB-001, ROB-002), and the async run did not reach 'Send follow-up'.
Failure states: no action made a request, so no failure run was possible.
Inline validation: the page has no form.
Phone navigation: the page has no navigation region.
Focus moving into an overlay and back, scroll lock, backdrop click and keyboard operation of the segmented controls (lens-a11y).
States reached only with real data or later steps.
